semantic.justification: Native optional fragment failure, basename lowercase retry, relation caching and strict/transitional root resolution; part-local/global relation ID counters and IURI conversion. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified. V4DQJW adds native FastSaxSerializer/FastSerializerHelper text/byte export, original1MiB cache, ordered token/value emission, XML10 and literal x-escape rules, APPEND/PREPEND/POSTPONE marks and original sorted buckets. XmlFilterBase now owns the native fragment-serializer factory with original no-header/VML/+xml predicate. Actual ZipFragmentStream/ZipStorage, OOXML token names and relationship/content-type owners are reused. Caller-provided actual FastTokenHandler replaces native component-service acquisition; no fake global context or token catalog is introduced. UTF16 host strings use the existing UTF8 byte transport binding; no exact claim is made for invalid UTF16 conversion or malformed UTF8 diagnostics. Native debug structural stacks remain unported; output preconditions retain the existing transport errors. File-local native invalidChar is exported only for source-scoped algorithm testing. FastAttributeList/VML raw-attribute overload, native numeric/double overloads and complete DOCX/XLSX export orchestration remain pending. No document/file UI behavior or whole-native parity is claimed; previous statuses and intentional file workflows remain unchanged. V4DQJW adds original transitional-only namespace lookup and empty fallback; restores the native addRelation part overload default external=false. Existing actual ZIP relation/content-type ownership and output routing remain unchanged. Package input now returns actual Reference<XInputStream> values over the existing genuine SequenceInputStream and signed Sequence storage, with empty Reference for absent parts. Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. Actual UNO read exceptions caught by XmlFilterBase are destroyed. Short-prefix EOF loss CALC-363/WRITER238 is preserved and directly tested. ZIP remains a browser byte/package binding: complete XStorage/XStream/XRelationshipAccess, input-disconnection lifecycle, generated token/UNO fragment/StringPair services, StorageBase hierarchy, libxml2 parity, native ABI/thread/allocation unwind and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain incomplete. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery policy is preserved. Native serializer byte owners now use genuine SAL ByteSequence/NODEFAULT cache storage, raw nElements mutation and toUnoSequence output aliases. ForMerge/ForSort own actual native sequence values, preserve native realloc/prepend/postpone/sort behavior and copy the merge value before pop. Stack/cache std::shared_ptr lifetime is explicitly lowered to a private local control count with virtual destruction, including failed destination switches. Helper endDocument destroys its moved serializer on success or error. ZipFragmentStream and relationship export consume initialized UNO byte Sequence values; host Uint8Array chunks remain only at the ZIP transport copy boundary. WRITER137/CALC-303 has a local retained-native-value alias witness without a COW correction. Full native output Reference/OWriteStream/parent storage/transaction/service and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Numeric/encoding edge cases, physical allocation/ABI/shared_ptr layout and debug-only guarantees stay unverified. Browser file/persistence policy is unchanged. Current checkpoint supersedes the historical carrier limitations: OFOP WriteRelationsInfoSequence and WriteContentSequence now consume actual XOutputStream/context/native StringPair sequences and registered source Writer. Attribute admission and failure occur in original order after root callbacks. Actual ManifestWriter implements the original XManifestWriter/XServiceInfo component, acquired context, exact package2 registration, native PropertyValue sequences and original SAXException-to-WrappedTargetRuntimeException wrapping with empty outer Message/Context. ManifestExport consumes the actual XDocumentHandler reference/native nested sequences and queries the original extended facet after startDocument. The duplicate XmlStringDocumentHandler encoder and five-callback alias are removed. Existing package string boundaries only bind actual native containers/stream bytes; no replacement XML encoder, fake provider or lazy core bootstrap exists. Dedicated Worker entrypoints own realm-local services; test fixtures initialize the same actual registry. Plain unencrypted OASIS admission remains bounded; legacy/encryption, full Sfx metadata/storage and final DOCX/XLSX core/shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Native physical ABI/allocator/debug/binary/timing parity is unqualified; previous coverage gaps stay open.
